verdict_reason: The tests mock only MdmClient and prove matching, caching per code and paging, but the empty-page stop and null total are untested and one title over-claims.

todos.issue: Two stop conditions of SpeciesCheckService.speciesOf have no test: the empty-page stop (speciesPage.content().isEmpty(), service line 48) and the missing total (totalElements() == null, line 47). Every paging test sets a total that ends the loop on its own, so deleting the empty-page guard leaves the suite green; that guard is what stops repeated MDM calls when MDM's total is larger than the species it actually returns.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails if the empty-page stop is removed, and a test pins what happens when MDM sends no total. One way: a test where page 0 has species with total 300 and page 1 is empty, asserting a species from page 0 is listed and that page 2 is never requested (an unstubbed page would throw under strict stubs); and a test with a page whose totalElements is null.

todos.issue: check_returnsEveryLine_forACodeMdmHasNoSpeciesFor (line 68) claims every line is returned, but the request holds one line (line 71), so the assertion proves only that a single line comes back.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertions prove. One way: send two lines under 030111 with different Latin names and assert both come back, or retitle to check_returnsTheLine_forACodeMdmHasNoSpeciesFor.
